title: Public Evidence Bundle section: deterministic answer outcomes
description: Deterministic answer acceptance over the authenticated product path. Records only closed Answer Execution Outcomes and bounded counters; complete model answers are never part of the bundle.

outcome.description: One of the four closed Answer Execution Outcomes; never reconstructed from flags or strings.

citations_count.description: Number of cited sources; identity of the Answer Evidence Set lives in the internal run, not in the public bundle.

contract.description: Whether normal, SSE, and history projections of the outcome matched.
